listen_address.description: IP address the exporter-exporter reverse proxy listens on.

listen_port.description: Port number the exporter-exporter reverse proxy listens on.

targets.description: List of upstream Prometheus exporter endpoints to proxy (format: host:port).

log_level.description: Verbosity of logs. Leave empty to use default.

upstream_timeout_seconds.description: Timeout in seconds for connecting to upstream exporters.

metrics_path.description: Path used to fetch metrics from upstream exporters (usually /metrics).

verify_tls.description: Whether to verify TLS certificates of HTTPS exporters.

upstream_basic_auth.description: HTTP basic auth credentials to use when fetching metrics from upstream exporters.
